Task: Managed Object Storage

Write Python code that reads object metadata or head information from managed object storage using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
import os

from google.cloud import storage

def get_object_metadata(bucket_name: str, object_name: str) -> dict:
    """Reads object metadata from Google Cloud Storage."""
    # Instantiates a client
    storage_client = storage.Client()

    # Get a bucket object
    bucket = storage_client.bucket(bucket_name)

    # Get a blob (object) object
    blob = bucket.blob(object_name)

    # Reload the blob to get its latest metadata
    # This sends a HEAD request to the object.
    blob.reload()

    metadata = {
        "name": blob.name,
        "bucket": blob.bucket.name,
        "size": blob.size,
        "content_type": blob.content_type,
        "time_created": blob.time_created,
        "updated": blob.updated,
        "etag": blob.etag,
        "crc32c": blob.crc32c,
        "md5_hash": blob.md5_hash,
        "storage_class": blob.storage_class,
        "kms_key_name": blob.kms_key_name,
        "custom_metadata": blob.metadata, # This holds user-defined metadata
    }
    return metadata
